description: You are a Process Validation Engineer at OfficeTech Manufacturing conducting a readiness review before your annual FDA 21 CFR Part 820 Quality System Regulation inspection. During your audit of the quality control point (QCP) records, you found that several QCPs do not have a 'Failure Message' configured — meaning inspectors receive no guidance when a check fails. Per your company's documented inspection procedures, every QCP must have a failure message that clearly instructs the inspector what action to take upon failure. Add a meaningful, specific failure message to every quality control point that currently lacks one. Additionally, your product validation team has identified a gap: there is no measurement-based QCP for the 'Customizable Desk' product covering the height adjustment mechanism. Create a new quality control point of type 'Measure' for the Customizable Desk product that verifies the desk height adjustment force is within specification, and include a clear failure message on this new control point as well. Log in to the quality management system at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin.
